title: On Publishing the maps in one thin book
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：publish　|　正文 350 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 publish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the athlete ① published the maps in one thin book twice over, and every trainer in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the athlete ② publishes the maps in one thin book year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ publish the maps in one thin book at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ published the maps in one thin book before — a line in the programme for September 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Publishing the maps in one thin book twice over, the athlete said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ publish the accounts every March year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Publish the accounts every March at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new trainer from the next stadium ⑧ publishes the accounts every March twice over every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the track, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ published the maps in one thin book again when nobody else would.

⑩ To publish the maps in one thin book, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the stadium remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the stadium forgets, somebody publishes the maps in one thin book year after year again and somebody must publish the maps in one thin book twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 出版（一般过去式 published the maps in one thin book：1973 年运动员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 出版（一般现在 publishes the maps in one thin book：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 出版（不定式 to publish the maps in one thin book：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 出版（过去完成时 had published the maps in one thin book：1967 年九月的秩序册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 出版（动名词 publishing the maps in one thin book 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 公布（publish the accounts every March：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去公布每年三月公布账目）
G. v. 公布（publish the accounts every March：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 出版（后段两处：新来的陪练照例 publishes the accounts every March，而母亲又一次 published the maps in one thin book）

answers.why: publish 意为“出版”，1973 年运动员来回两遍出版把那些地图印成一本薄书，那是体育场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 published。
publish 意为“出版”，自那以后运动员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 publishes。
publish 意为“出版”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯出版把那些地图印成一本薄书”，此处为不定式 to publish the maps in one thin book。
publish 意为“出版”，秩序册里 九月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人出版过，故用过去完成时 had published。
publish 意为“出版”，运动员说“出版把那些地图印成一本薄书这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 publishing the maps in one thin book 作主语。
publish 意为“公布”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去公布每年三月公布账目”，should ever 之后用原形 publish the accounts every March。
publish 意为“公布”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻公布每年三月公布账目（publish the accounts every March at once），以后再也不要提起。
publish 意为“出版”，新来的陪练每个年份都照例公布每年三月公布账目，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 publishes。
publish 意为“出版”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍出版把那些地图印成一本薄书，用一般过去式 published 叙述。
publish 意为“出版”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要出版把那些地图印成一本薄书，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和体育场记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 publish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the athlete published the maps in one thin book twice over, and nobody in the stadium forgot it.
Even now the athlete publishes the maps in one thin book year after year whenever the stadium asks.
Publishing the maps in one thin book twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever publish the accounts every March year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainer from the next stadium publishes the accounts every March twice over every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother published the maps in one thin book again, and the stadium remembered that half.
